'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Wayne Cullen DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Wayne Cullen]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Username:''' KissMyWookiee
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
